title: ISP Brownout Detection
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes (`uptime:probe`).
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=speedtest:result
| bin _time span=1h
| stats avg(download_mbps) as download, avg(latency_ms) as latency by _time
| where download<100 AND latency>50
| sort - _time
description: Identifies brownouts where connectivity still exists but bandwidth and latency are bad enough to ruin real work or streaming.
value: Outage detectors miss the frustrating middle state where the line is technically alive and effectively unusable; this query catches that gap.
implementation: Schedule regular speed tests into `index=personal`; alert on hours with low throughput and elevated latency together.
visualization: Timeline of speed-test throughput and latency with brownout windows highlighted.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when your internet has not fully gone down but has become so slow and laggy that it may as well have.
